steps: Peel and dice mango into chunks, then place in a blender.
Add coconut milk, coconut yogurt, and vanilla extract to the blender.
Blend until completely smooth, about 30 seconds.
Pour mixture into a large bowl and stir in chia seeds.
Let the mixture rest for 10 minutes, stirring once, until slightly thickened.
Spoon evenly into a 16-cup silicone mini-muffin tray.
Freeze for at least 3 hours, until fully set and firm throughout.
Pop bites out and serve slightly thawed for 2 minutes. Keep frozen up to 1 month.
